headline: US-Iran Conflict Escalates, Threatening Strait of Hormuz Blockade and Global Semiconductor Supply Chain.
summary: The third week of the US-Iran conflict brings the Strait of Hormuz to the brink of blockade, a move projected to cripple Taiwan's semiconductor industry and trigger a global chip supply crisis. This geopolitical escalation is also causing a critical helium shortage, directly impacting semiconductor manufacturing and data center operations worldwide.
